notes: All five v2 browser-format checkpoints and four legacy checkpoints are included and verified locally.
The default is v2 fold 0, without mirroring, using the same web weights as the browser.
Use --folds 0,1,2,3,4 for the full v2 ensemble, and --mirror for test-time mirroring.
Use --pipeline legacy-v1 for the previous four-network consensus.
The optional --model fp32 weights need a separate download before offline use.
Use --top-n and --threshold to match the browser automation settings.
DICOM input and manual mask editing use the web app.
Software parity uses a synthetic fixture; a representative clinical reference is pending.
